sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: Indonesia's geothermal build-out is accelerating on PLN's grid expansion and fiscal incentives, making PGEO a structural compounder regardless of global rate swings.
Green ammonia and downstream nickel processing are becoming Indonesia's climate-tech export moats, insulated from US tariff and subsidy volatility.
US climate-tech weakness is cyclical, not structural—capital will rotate back once rate-cut timing firms, favoring liquid US names over illiquid Indonesian small caps.
sectors.ai: Buy selective geothermal and green-ammonia names on Indonesia's domestic demand pull, but stay defensive on US-exposed climate-tech. PGEO's rerating signals policy-driven upside; add on dips, trim US-linked plays until Fed clarity.

sectors.name: Consumer & FMCG

Packaging and plastics-linked consumer firms (PDES, INDR) are gaining on input-cost stabilization and export-driven volume recovery, offering durable margin expansion into 2025.
sectors.ai: Buy selective small/mid-cap FMCG names showing volume-price breakouts (PDES, ADES, AGAR) while large caps lag; momentum is broad but fragile, so take profits on 10%+ single-day spikes. Favor water/beverage and packaging sub-sectors for earnings visibility; avoid chasing BTEK without confirmation. Position for a 2-4 week hold as IDX consumer breadth improves, but trim if aggregate signal flips negative.
